caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench with a high, decorative backrest that features a scalloped and wavy top edge and visible wood grain texture throughout. The bench is composed of light brown wood and consists of a flat seat supported by four legs, two armrests, and several horizontal and vertical supports. Two turned vertical spindles connect the seat to the backrest, providing both structural support and decorative detail. The structure of the bench is shown in three-quarter perspective, with the right side receding to give a sense of depth. There is minimal shading, and the background is a plain off-white color. The artist’s signature and location—“Hazel G. Claflin, Taos, N.M.”—are written in small black letters in the lower right corner.
title: Church Bench - Wooden
